scope: Replay published prediction files, NOT model inference or training reproduction
labels: Accept only entailment/non-entailment/neutral/contradiction; explicitly map last two to non-entailment; reject others
checks: all 96 author groups match independent counts
pinned data and evaluator hashes match previous run
limits: Four repository files are not four retrained models or seed averages. Report their exact measured results, not equivalence to every paper table or modern model rankings. No Rust functionality labels.
